description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades, including functions 'platform_check_image' and 'platform_do_upgrade', that execute commands based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for the platform, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform upgrade, calling 'default_do_upgrade' for all board types.
